text: Ironvale Athletic successfully shifted momentum around the 86th minute by exploiting their 5-3-2 formation's direct, vertical passing style from a deep defensive line, allowing rapid counter-attacks and four final third entries in eight minutes. Their disciplined low block forced Redmond Rovers into limited possession and low box presence, enabling Ironvale to regain control with superior pass accuracy (78.0%), leading to sustained pressure and multiple shots prior to Ilias Thorne's decisive goal. Redmond’s high press and quick circulation were effectively neutralized, highlighting a failure to break down Ironvale’s compact defense in this phase. Coaching point: To counter a low block and direct counters, work with your team on quick transitional plays and exploitation of wider areas to disrupt compact defensive setups.
